newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunker fuel edges up despite sagging crude.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunker fuel edges up despite sagging crude.

text.p: ARA bunker fuel oil prices were slightly stronger on Wednesday, despite weakening crude oil futures, bunker traders said.
"It has gone up at the last moment," one said, adding she thought it was more a result of individual players' trading strategies than of supply/demand considerations.
But dealers said activity was thin, and this had engendered some volatility. The recent strong demand ahead of the holiday period now appears to have been catered for, traders said.
Saudi Aramco raised A-888 bunker diesel prices from Ras Tanura and Dammam by $3 a tonne to $238 from December 19.
A-888 from Jeddah and Yanbu were a dollar up at $236 a tonne, while A0960 bunkers were unchanged at $125.
Prices in Fujairah for 380 cst material were a dollar or two stronger amid adequate demand for product.
Prices in most other centres were little changed.
